notes.title: Bug Fixes & Optimizations
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have been working on some new things, but we had to drop an update to address some issue with players and the Quest 3 headset. This update fixes all movement issues.

This update addresses a variety of issues and contains some optimizations.

Bugs
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Meta Quest 3 headsets not able to get past tutorial.
[*] Fixed issue with weapons sometimes not saving to inventory.
[*] Fixed issue with some doors getting stuck on player body.
[*] Fixed issue with some subtitles not showing correctly.
[*] Fixed some lighting issues in the dirt lot level.
[*] Fixed lighting issue in main factory.
[*] Fixed issue with hand disappearing if two handed weapon we held at foregrip.
[/list]

Optimizations
[list]
[*] Performed an optimization pass in the main factory
[*] Reduced the memory footprint for a few levels
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes

This is a patch to fix some bugs that have been discovered since the last release.

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed subtitles rendering incorrectly in tutorial during blackness
[*] Fixed knife not always penetrating skull of ragdolls
[*] Fixed underwater effects not always working correctly
[*] Fixed physics issue with ragdolls and water

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
We've been receiving a lot of inquiries about the status of our current major update and wanted to give you a quick update on our progress.

We're excited to announce that we're getting closer to completion and are in the final stages of development. We're now looking for a few testers who own an Index headset and knuckles controllers, as well as a Windows Mixed Reality headset. If you're interested in helping us test the update, please reach out to us on Discord https://discord.gg/g7vYGudHF3.

We're happy to report that we've overcome most of the technical hurdles we've faced and can see the light at the end of the tunnel. Thank you for your patience and support, and stay tuned for further updates

notes.title: Major Update Coming
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Hope you’re enjoying your 4th of July weekend! We have been pretty quiet recently and for a good reason. We have had quite a few changes in the last couple of weeks. If you don’t know already, we are a husband and wife dev team…and my partner/wife just gave birth to our son a couple of weeks ago. So a new addition to the team!

With that said, we have been quite busy. But very excited to also let you all know that we are still hard at work and working on a major update! And yes, this will include full Index Controllers support with finger tracking. We will also include a HUGE amount of refinements and fixes. Too many to list here...but over the course of the next few weeks, we will be giving more information. This update will take a bit of time, and we are committed to make it happen as soon as we can.

As always, thank you for your understanding and continued support!

Steve & Pamela

notes.notes:
This update contains a small optimization that should increase performance and contains bug fixes discovered by the community.

Players should see a slight performance increase. This is especially noticable on computers that have slower CPU's.

[b]Enhancement[/b]
[*] Updated M9 textures

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with the undead going through closed doors in various locations
[*] Fixed issue with first rush not completing under certain instances
[*] Fixed issue with player able to walk into cabinets in the main factory level
[*] Fixed grab indicator for some items in suburb level
[*] Fixed issue with Knife attachment appearing in early level
[*] Fixed audio issue with conveyor belts
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2 : Black screen when loading bug Fixed
notes.notes:
There have been some players experiencing an endless black screen when loading into the game. After some digging and with the help of a player experiencing the issue, we were able to get it fixed. If you were experiencing the problem at any time...this should completely resolve it

Along with that the below issues have also been resolved.

[b]Additional Fixes[/b]
Fixed locker room lockers to better blend in with the environment.
Increased zombie sounds during outside area before sewer.
Fixed various occlusion issues that were causing some objects to disappear in the main factory
Fixed some map out of bounds issues

notes.title: Two Enhancements, Bug Fixes, and much Smaller Updates (data wise) going forward
notes.notes:
Two Enhancements and Various Bug Fixes

This weeks update brings a couple of improvements and some bug fixes. The red dot scopes now behave as they should and adjust based on the angle at which they are viewed.

We also added an adjustment as requested by the community for Snap Turning. First, we have made it more responsive. Secondly, it's now possible to control the blink duration or shut it off completely.

Also, going forward, the updates will be much smaller data wise. We made adjustments to how the game is built to accommodate people with slower/data capped internet.

Enhancements
[list]
[*] Red dot scopes now behave correctly
[*] Option to adjust snap turn blink duration
[/list]


[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Some zombies not dying when shot in head
[*] Glass rendering under certain conditions
[*] Minor Map issues in both the suburbs and smoke stack area
[*] Fixed tree animation in suburbs
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1: Grip Angle Adjustment Option
notes.notes:
This update brings a requested feature by the community. The ability to change the angle of pistols when holding them. 

We have also added an option to turn on dynamic shadows for the player's flashlight. It's located in the options menu for shadows. It's only recommended for players with higher end GPUs, but anyone with a GTX 2080/equivalent or higher should be able to run it with no issues.

[b]New Features[/b]
Added: Option to change Pistol grip angle 
Added: Option for flashlight dynamic shadows on higher end GPUs

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed: Map fixes for Suburb
Fixed: Special items not shown as found in Main Menu
Fixed: Achievement for finding special items not resetting during second play through
Fixed: Knife no longer triggers Gunsmith achievement
Fixed: Issue when players went back to the scissor lift

[b]Changes[/b]
Changed: Loading scene image
Changed: Upscaled dirt lot Skybox

notes.title: Hotfix 2- Resolved Game Start Up Issue
notes.notes:
Some of of you may have noticed that there was an update late yesterday, now that it is verified by members of the community experiencing the issue, we want to update everyone else.

This update fixes the game not launching on start up for some players. If you have previously set your game over to one of the Beta branches, you can now opt out of the Beta to receive this update as its now safe to do so.

Additional Bug fix:
[list]
[*] Fixed - Player hands not snapping back to controller when grabbing certain items
[/list]
Many thanks to the community for helping us to get to the root cause of these issues. 

Now that these critical issues have been fixed, we are working on a highly requested feature, so stay tuned for this next announcement!

notes.title: Hotfix- Walkie Talkie Bug
notes.notes:
Some players were affected by a bug where they could not progress when picking up the walkie talkie.

We have tracked down the issue to players in certain regions being affected by the Windows language settings on their PC. This patch directly fixes that issue and many others caused by it.

A big shout out to LFulciFan and other players who brought this issue to our attention, you were all instrumental in helping us track it down.

notes.title: The Days After – Update Re-Launch
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gaming aficionados!!
 
It’s been some time since our last update, as we have been hard at work progressing on The Days
After.  As we continue development and move towards a near release date, we thought this would be a good time to re-engage the community and provide regular updates on game development, while receiving feedback and suggestions from your collective hours of gaming experience.
 
Like you, we are avid gamers and our goal is to deliver a VR gaming experience that players
want and deserve for their hard earned coin, without repeating the mistakes made by other
developers consumed in the grip of the cash grab.
 
First, allow me to share with you who we are, how we got here, what we are accomplishing, and
how you can help.
 
Five Finger Studios is an independent gaming company consisting of a small group of individuals.
How small? Uh…yea, well, there are two of us. Three years ago we quit our jobs and have been
focusing on the development of The Days After, full-time, with some support and mentorship
from major headset makers, and VR industry experts. No turning back now.
 
The Days After takes place in a post-event zombie apocalypse. A story driven kill-fest, using
some seen before, as well as some improved game mechanics. Well balanced puzzles that allow the player to interact with the world and utilize items to craft things to their advantage. We have also optimized the game to run and look good on a wide range of PC specifications and VR headsets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/cf00a806adb435691afb66ae8a35e6929df21cbd.png[/img]
 
While in development we continue to keep an eye on new and innovative gaming techniques,
ideas, community feedback, and frankly, VR game releases. The recent game releases (we all
know what they are) as of late, have been both inspirational and impressive, and a strong catalyst for
our desire to develop a great game. Let’s be honest, we all have our own ideas of what makes a
great VR game, and we want to hear yours.
 
Every time we don on our headsets and dive into a new or sometimes old game, we
wonder…”What works? What doesn’t work? How can we make it better?”

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RhBXnJ5jQAHoAZTWRG/giphy.gif[/img]
 
We take our answers to these questions and try to incorporate them into The Days After, but we can’t
do it alone.  In the name of progress and delivering the gaming experience that captures the best
of all your ideas and leaves the “what’s wrong” on the cutting room floor, we will be fully
engaging in the Steam Community Board to update you on game progress, schedules, screen
shots, game mechanics, and most importantly, solicit suggestions.  Your participation is kindly
requested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32995586/9b6f5ecc09200d57d7c027041a0e87c830d815d4.png[/img]

In the meantime, here is a list of links to refresh your memory and keep you occupied until the
next update.  We will provide regular updates to the Steam Board, so click on
the “follow” button to make sure you don’t miss anything.
